lines: Nitin Mahajan, Investor Selling Shareholder, is due proceeds from selling 83,167 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of ₹1.26 crore are scheduled on or about Friday, October 23, 2026, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Gain of ₹1.15 crore before offer expenses and taxes; retained shares follow a 6 months lock-in from allotment.
Caveat: pre-offer holding is unknown, as it is not confirmed from the documents.
